baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate action enters an exact scale whose smallest positive unit remains perceptible to its agent.

activation_trace.role: Intentional doing supplies deliberate human agency as the input to the accounting mechanism.
Standard weight and weighing supplies exact calibration rather than a vague estimate.
Tiny scattered motes supply the limiting case that tests whether any good can disappear.
Desired and beneficial good supplies the positive moral value being preserved.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies perceptible encounter as the mechanism's endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Even a very small good deed will somehow matter.
changed_reading.after: Every intentional good, down to the smallest calibrated unit, is preserved until its agent perceptibly encounters it.

baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase overlays physical minuteness with evaluative weight, reversing the assumption that small scale entails small worth.

activation_trace.role: Weight as preciousness and rank supplies qualitative worth alongside quantitative measure.
The tiny scattered mote supplies maximal physical slightness against which worth is reassessed.
Virtue and chosen excellence supplies value that need not track outward size.
Reflective judgment supplies the reassessment by which apparently negligible good is recognized as weighty.

changed_reading.before: The mote is merely a lower quantitative threshold.
changed_reading.after: The mote stages a scale reversal: physically minute good can still carry precious evaluative weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Whole-earth upheaval and the extraction of its burdens establish a macro disclosure process; the focus ayah contracts that process to one person's mote-weight good.

activation_trace.role: Disturbance and shaking supplies the force that breaks the scene's prior stability and concealment.
Bringing a thing out of hiding supplies the disclosure movement from interior concealment to exterior presence.
Physical or assessed heaviness supplies the earth-scale burden against which the focus ayah's tiny weight is set.
Standard weighing converts the context's mass disclosure into exact individual calibration.
The tiny mote supplies the microscopic counterpart to the earth's plural burdens.
Making something seen supplies the final presentation of what upheaval has exposed.

structural_cues: 99:1-2 move from the whole earth to its plural burdens, while 99:7 narrows the scale to one agent and one mote-weight good.
The sequence runs from disturbance through extraction to later individual visibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaking, extraction from hiding, and burdens; I infer that a deed can be modeled as a concealed deposit disclosed by upheaval. The burdens could instead be bodies or other contents, in which case the macro-to-micro scale analogy remains without the deposit claim.

changed_reading.before: A tiny good is accurately noticed.
changed_reading.after: A tiny good is a concealed moral burden that the same disclosure process operating on the earth extracts and places before its agent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth becomes an authorized reporting medium: concealed knowledge is converted into testimony, so seeing the good becomes confrontation with disclosed evidence rather than bare visual perception.

activation_trace.role: Speech renewed as report supplies the earth's transition from mute setting to articulate witness.
Knowledge of a report and an affair's interior supplies informed testimony rather than mere surface display.
Sovereignty and mastery supplies the authority under which the disclosure occurs.
Hidden imparting of knowledge supplies the earth's access to what it will report.
Writing and engraving supplies an archival analogy for acts retained until disclosure.
Showing and making seen supplies the conversion of testimony into evidence presented to the agent.

structural_cues: The human question in 99:3 is answered in 99:4-5 by the earth's reporting under command.
The feminine pronouns keep the earth as the continuous reporting medium before 99:7 shifts to the singular human recipient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reporting, inward knowledge, sovereign authorization, hidden communication, and an engraving branch; I infer an authorized record-witness that retains acts. A live alternative is that the agent sees only the act's consequence or recompense, not an evidentiary presentation of the act itself.

changed_reading.before: The agent directly sees a good act or its outcome.
changed_reading.after: The agent is confronted with an authorized disclosure in which the smallest good is made evidentially present.

context_deltas.mechanism: A departing and dispersed human multitude is made to see its deeds; the focus ayah zooms from that collective staging to the irreducible one-agent, one-act encounter.

activation_trace.role: Departure from a point of arrival supplies directed movement into the display scene.
Dispersion and separation supplies differentiation within the human multitude.
Causing to see supplies an externally staged presentation rather than optional self-inspection.
Intentional deeds supplies the plural corpus being presented to the dispersed people.
Intentional doing narrows the plural deed corpus to one agent's concrete input.
Exact weighing supplies the per-act resolution of the collective display.
Direct perception supplies the singular agent's realized encounter with what was shown collectively.

structural_cues: 99:6 uses a plural human subject, dispersed groups, and a causative showing of plural deeds.
99:7 immediately recasts that scene through the singular conditional 'whoever' and a singular pronominal object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure, dispersion, caused seeing, and plural deeds; I infer that dispersion individuates accounts and that 99:7 supplies one microscopic case. The groups may instead mark classes or destinations, but the singular conditional still personalizes the disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The line is a general maxim applying to any person.
changed_reading.after: The crowd-level display resolves into a one-person case in which each separated agent is made to confront each calibrated act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the entire action-measure-particle-visibility pipeline while replacing good with evil, making the focus ayah the positive side of a valence-symmetric disclosure system.

activation_trace.role: Intentional doing supplies the same agentive input on the negative side.
Standard weighing supplies an unchanged calibration rule across moral valences.
The tiny mote supplies the same lower bound on the negative side.
Evil and harm supplies the polarity reversal while the surrounding mechanism remains fixed.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the same perceptible endpoint for the negative side.
Beneficial good supplies the positive pole whose separate preservation the mirror construction highlights.

structural_cues: 99:7 and 99:8 repeat the same word-root sequence around the sole lexical substitution of good and evil.
The adjacent singular conditionals preserve agent, scale, and perceptual endpoint on both sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an almost invariant paired construction with only moral polarity changed; I infer that each valence is separately preserved rather than silently netted away. The pair could instead express comprehensive range without specifying whether final judgment aggregates the two sides.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah is an isolated assurance that tiny good will be seen.
changed_reading.after: The assurance is one half of a symmetric ledger: good follows the same exact disclosure path as evil and is not lost merely because the account also contains its opposite.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it recasts an accounting clause as gestation and growth. It remains anchored through co-occurring focus branches for a load becoming heavy in pregnancy, pregnancy becoming visible, and gentle emergence, sharpened by fertile earth and extraction. Render it only as an analogy for latency becoming visible, not as a lexical claim that the focus words denote gestation.

activation_trace.role: A pregnancy becoming heavy supplies a carried-latency stage in which consequence develops before disclosure.
Pregnancy becoming outwardly visible supplies the transition from hidden development to manifest sign.
Gentle spreading emergence, including first growth, supplies the tiny beginning's unfolding.
Soft fertile earth supplies the material setting for hidden growth.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the culmination in exposed presence.
Beneficial good supplies the moral content carried through the growth analogy.

changed_reading.before: The smallest good is a static item placed on a scale.
changed_reading.after: The smallest good can be carried like a latent beginning whose accumulated consequence eventually becomes visibly manifest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends partly on the packet's non-dominant ش ر ي mapping attached to 99:8's ش ر ر, not on the ordinary meaning of evil. It remains anchored because focus عمل itself supplies transaction and wage branches while مثقال supplies weighing. Render settlement only as a cross-root associative model, never as a translation equating evil with sale.

activation_trace.role: Dealing or transaction between people supplies an exchange frame for the action.
Wage or pay for work supplies the possibility of a return corresponding to action.
Standard weight and weighing supplies exact settlement rather than rough equivalence.
Beneficence and gift supplies the positive value transferred or returned.
The non-dominant sale-and-purchase branch supplies a deliberately form-distant exchange activation.
Matching and correspondence supplies the counterpart relation between deed and disclosed return.
Making seen supplies presentation of the settled counterpart to the actor.

changed_reading.before: The agent simply observes a tiny good deed or result.
changed_reading.after: The smallest good enters an exactly weighed settlement and returns to its actor as a visible counterpart or credit.

strongest_changes: The earth's extracted burdens turn the mote-weight good into the microscopic instance of a world-scale disclosure process.
The earth's authorized report turns seeing into confrontation with testimony, not merely visual awareness.
The dispersed crowd and causative showing resolve into an individualized encounter, while 99:8 makes the same mechanism symmetric across good and evil.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah concentrates the surrounding surah's macro upheaval, reporting earth, and collective display into one exact human encounter. The most unusual live activations were a latency-to-manifestation model built from pregnancy and emergence branches, and an exact-settlement model supported by focus transaction branches plus a non-dominant split-root cue.
remaining_uncertainties: The pronoun's encountered object may be the deed itself, its evidentiary record, its consequence, or its recompense.
The paired good and evil clauses strongly preserve both sides but do not by themselves settle whether final judgment also aggregates them.
The gestation and exchange models are branch-backed analogies and should not be promoted to lexical glosses.
